newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Pall Corp to invest $11 mln in Irish plant.
newsitem.headline: Pall Corp to invest $11 mln in Irish plant.

text.p: Filter manufacturer Pall Corp is to invest $11 million in a healthcare filter manufacturing operation that will create 250 jobs in Tipperary town in the Irish midlands, the Irish government said on Friday.
The new facility, which is being supported by Irish industrial development agency IDA Ireland, will be located in the former Tambrands factory in the town, the government said in a statement.
The plant will manufacture medical filters to supply Pall's current European requirements as well as providing additional capacity to meet the growing demand for its products in Europe.
